digest.component_or_area: attestation validity and plan-review pin enforcement
propositions: An optional boolean configuration enforce_plan_material_pins controls whether pin drift, missing targets, or malformed pin records invalidate plan-review attestations.

Derived plan material pin health must compare signed pins against current narrow material and report status as current, stale-pin-drift, stale-pin-missing, malformed-pin, or legacy-unpinned, with fixed severity ordering.
Pin health derivation must fail open on config read errors and non-raising errors for unreadable targets, emitting structured warnings while preserving legacy-unpinned semantics.

Attestation validity profiles DEFAULT, CLOSE, and DRIFT_REFRESH control which checks run; CLOSE and DRIFT_REFRESH disable only code freshness while retaining signature, registry, own-material, and pin checks.

When re-signing a plan-review attestation, the helper must validate reviewed_related_material pins persisted in the sidecar before enabling enforcement, blocking re-sign on drift or missing targets when enabled.

Full LLM plan reviews must thread the pre-review related_material snapshot through sidecar.emit and build_payload as an optional reviewed_related_material field, preserving it for failed-sign recovery without fabricating a certified attestation.
